potatoes, pressure, patience

Settings

Controls

Aim
Drag the launcher: sideways turns it, up and down moves the peg. Or tap the map to point it there.
Roll
Grab the launcher by its wheels and drag sideways.
Pump / fire
Tap the hand pump (hold to keep pumping). Tap the blue valve handle to fire.
Look around
Two fingers on the field, or right-drag / Shift-drag; the mouse wheel zooms.
Map
⤢ makes it bigger. Pinch it or use the mouse wheel over it to zoom. Drag the red dotted line to aim. Drag anywhere else to move the map about (once zoomed in); a tap aims there (a pin shows how far).

Keys

←→ rotate (Shift for 2°)
↑↓ peg hole
AD roll
Space pump · B bleed
Enter fire · M sound
